nodes.title: Director reply-model A/B: taxila-fast (director2, cb999f79) vs taxila-gpt6 (fb995233), the same 12 scripted lessons (c4/c5/c6 × 4 scenarios), classify on fast in both. One Claude judge read all 240 turns; not blind; the arms are on slightly different heads. Lesson wins: fast 4, gpt6 4, even 4. Defects ≈ 22 (fast) vs ≈ 21 (gpt6) plus 8 gpt6 guard fallbacks. Real worked examples fast 3 + 5 partial vs gpt6 1 + 3. gpt6 better at handling the child's words and in real Hindi; worse at worked examples, repetition and missed wrong answers. Reply-ready p50 2.52 vs 3.21 s (+0.69), p90 3.56 vs 4.54 s (+0.98); ~6× cost.

Keep taxila-fast as the Director reply model on every turn, teaching turns included. Why: jd-r7-reply-model-ab-2026-11-04 shows no teaching gain for taxila-gpt6 (it is worse on worked examples and repetition) at +0.7 s p50 and ~6× cost; the shared defects are upstream (Director and kit) and are addressed by S2/S3. Reverse: after S2-S5, an A/B on the same head shows the stronger model clearly better at teaching for ≤ 0.5 s.

md.measurements:
## jd-r7-reply-model-ab-2026-11-04 (main loop, 2026-11-04)

Method: stream A's harness, Director-only. Arm A taxila-fast (results/2026-11-04-director2, cb999f79); arm B taxila-gpt6 (results/2026-11-04-gpt6-ab, fb995233). Classify on taxila-fast in both. n = 12 lessons per arm (c4/c5/c6 × steady/offtopic/stuck/steering), the same scripted Hinglish child. One Claude judge read all 240 teacher turns; not blind; the arms differ slightly in code repairs. Wins 4/4/4. Worked examples: A 3 real + 5 partial, B 1 + 3. B had 8 guard fallbacks. Latency from the json: p50 2.52 vs 3.21 s, p90 3.56 vs 4.54 s. Cost ~$0.21 vs ~$1.26.
md.decisions:
## dc-r7-reply-model-fast (2026-11-04, main loop)

The Director's reply model stays taxila-fast on every turn. The stronger taxila-gpt6 gave no teaching gain (fewer real worked examples, more repetition, missed wrong answers), though it handled the child's words and Hindi a little better, at +0.7 s p50 and ~6× cost. The shared defects come from the Director and the kits, and S2/S3 address them. Reversal: after S2-S5, a same-head A/B shows the stronger model clearly better at teaching for ≤ 0.5 s extra.
